description: Portos públicos no RS (2016) is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Período: 2016. Descrição: 8 portos públicos no RS. Fontes: MT e MI; ANTAQ; ANTT; DNIT (VGEO - Visualizador de Informações Geográficas do Departamento Nacional de Infraestrutura de Transportes); ST RS; SPH RS; SPRG; PELT/RS P3 – Parte 1/2 (jun 2014); RUMOS 2015; Google Earth e Google Maps; outros. Categoria temática: Infraestrutura. Data dos metadados: 10/2021. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Porto, Porto Público, transportation, structure, location. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
